entries.street_address: c/o Judy Cohen and Eileen Kennedy, 91 Rossmore Rd #3
entries.land_description: Located in Frankfort, midcoast Maine, 12 miles west of Belfast and four hours from Boston. We are two separatists, currently Boston-based, looking for dyke builder(s) to help construct first cabin. Will pay $ and/or trade. Land is available for camping, healing work, wimmin's outdoor groups, feminist camps, retreats, homesteading and gardening. Young forest, southern exposure and some meadows with mountain views. Views of lake and Penobscot Bay. Lots of trails. Great for hiking and skiing. Surrounded by undeveloped land and adjacent to another lesbian's 54 acres with stream.
entries.welcomed_groups: visitors, new members/residents, girl children, nonlesbian women, limited number of dogs
entries.notes: No smoking, alcohol or drugs of any kind. We are/have: 2 lesbians, 100 acres, woods, inactive farmland, camping space.

entries.land_description: Our land is both fields and woods, with hundreds of acres of preserved tree farm and forest surrounding us. We are two lesbians and three cats who built our own home on the magnificent coast of Maine.
entries.welcomed_groups: visitors, girl/boy children, nonlesbian women, well-behaved dogs
entries.notes: We are a smoke, drug and alcohol free home. We love to connect with other women and welcome campers for short visits. It's best to come after blackfly season, which ends around June 30th. (there are strict leash laws in ME). We are/have: 2 lesbians, 10, acres, housing/permanent structures, plumbing, electricity, woods, farmland, camping space, women living and working on the land.

entries.land_description: Remote central Maine - primitive woods, self-contained tent camping with access to well water, nearby lake, hiking trails. Also small 2-room rustic cabin for rent. In midcoast Maine (Surry), we have a 2-room rustic cabin for rent with salt water access.
entries.notes: Chem free. We are/have: 2 lesbians, 60 acres, housing/permanent structures, woods, camping space, women living on the land.

entries.land_description: Coventree is a primitive homestead currently occupied by five goats, three cats, one dog and one womn. It is a sanctuary for womn of like mind and all life. It is a remembering ground. It is womn only space. I hope that at some other womn will also caregive this land with me.
entries.welcomed_groups: visitors, new members/residents, girl children, nonlesbian women
entries.notes: I am/have: housing/permanent structures, woods, farmland, camping space, woman living and working on the land.

entries.num_residents: women's peace camp with numbers varying depending on time of year
entries.land_description: The Peace Camp maintains a presence outside the Seneca Army Depot, a storage site for nuclear weapons. A feminist community based on consensus and nonviolence, we're committed to making corrections among sexism, racism, classism, and militarism.
entries.welcomed_groups: visitors, new members/residents, girl children, boy children up to 12, nonlesbian women, dogs
entries.notes: Any womn is welcome to visit or stay as long as she wants. The house is alcohol and drug free space, but smoking is allowed in one room. Men can be on part of the land until 9pm. We are/have: women's peace camp with numbers varying depending on time of year, 52 acres, housing/permanent structures, marginally accessible, plumbing (kind of), electricity, woods, camping space, women living and working on the land. The old QQ, we are: the new QQ we are: the same QQ stronger than before.
